text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam will host the second conference of Asia Pacific nations for solidarity with Cuba in Hanoi next week.
-- Vietnam will strictly punish polluting production facilities as part of its efforts to protect the environment.
-- The industry ministry has proposed a $30-million plan to revitalize the country's electric fan production.
-- The First Deputy President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Hassan Habibi, will visit Vietnam from June 18 to June 26.
-- The government will auction export-import quotas to crack down on bureaucracy.
-- Vietnam plans to improve water quality in the basins of the counrty's biggest rivers, including the Dong Nai and Hong rivers.
-- Hanoi will reinforce environmental protection in the city's residential areas and industrial parks.
-- Vietnam exported 460,000 tonnes of rice in May. So far this year 700,000 tonnes of paddy have been purchased for reserves in the southern Mekong delta.
